geometry.hold_note: fixed research cap from prior PF model; actual runtime hold cap must be reconciled

entry_model.activation: first full minute boundary at or after first_received_ms
entry_model.check: previous completed minute close vs plan TP1/SL before order formation; then quote proxy=open, limit=max(open,zone_low), WAIT above zone_high
entry_model.TTL_note: research horizon from receipt; original created/expires also recorded, mismatch blocks exact LIVE parity
entry_model.actual_runtime_overrides: UNKNOWN: tolerance/chase/better, FT scheduler/timeout/quotes. Defaults in this model are assumptions, not measured LIVE
entry_model.intra_minute_fill: high touch only price proxy, never guaranteed execution
entry_model.gapped_pending_entry: not filled before accepted order; gap above zone rejects new order
entry_model.admissibility: gate observations only as of decision, never carry actual A portfolio to C as causal counterfactual; missing evidence=UNKNOWN

execution.partial_events: timestamp at minute end; preserve original fractions, no same-bar BE assumption
execution.MFE_MAE: coarse whole entry/exit minute; not precise tick order

R.true_net_requires: complete funding cash/mark and execution evidence; otherwise model price R only

forward_registration.start: strictly after registration commit committer UTC time; original signal_ms AND first_received_ms must be later
forward_registration.freshness_evidence: append-only source log first_received + original id/times + GitHub batch commit timestamp; late/backfilled records segregated
forward_registration.collection: manual offline ingestion of owner-provided GitHub exports only; no service, scheduled workflow, exchange or Telegram session

analysis.paired_unit: all unique same signal ids for A/C; non-entry=0 only when fully observed; pending/data-gap never zero
analysis.primary_comparison: paired model net R per opportunity and per calendar week, not only conditional filled trades
analysis.regime: last completed BTC1m close vs last completed close24h earlier; DOWN<=-3%, UP>=3%, elseSIDEWAYS; missing=UNKNOWN
analysis.fixed_horizon: 8 calendar weeks minimum AND at least100 new fully closed independently eligible paper trades per A and C; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; no optional stopping based on profit
analysis.paired_uncertainty: resample whole UTC calendar weeks, 10000 samples, seed20261121; need>=8 fully observed weeks; no significance claim before complete data
analysis.promotion: owner minimum100 NEW shadow trades and >0.1R/trade; stronger comparative gate requires C positive at50bp, improvement A/C with paired lower95% bound>0 and no concentration dependence; no automatic LIVE change even if passed
